name: Fujian Dongbai (Group) Co.,Ltd.
summary: Fujian Dongbai (Group) Co.,Ltd. engages in commercial retail, and warehousing and logistics businesses in China. It operates stores, shopping malls, cultural, commercial, and tourism complexes, and online businesses, as well as operates through a combination of self-operation, joint ventures, and leasing.
